text:
maria: Heads-up — we have a conflict for the 09:00 UTC cutover window tomorrow. Candidate build 2026.03.20-rc2 is ready but finance needs the slot for a security patch deploy. Can we discuss pin/alternative windows?
alan: Oof. Is the finance patch time-block hard?
sasha: finance said 09:00 is required for external vendor, they can't move. We could shift our promo to 11:00, but that would push validations into EOD for APAC.
maria: Constraints: product wants canary at 09:00 to meet marketing deadline. Also we need the db migration to run pre-promote (30m).
kevin: If we move ours to 11:00 we lose canary coverage in EU morning. Not ideal. Is swapping with finance an option? @olga any go?
olga: I pinged their eng lead. Short answer: they can take 10:15 if we give them 09:00. But they insist on rollbacks being isolated (no shared infra) — will need reserved nodes.
maria: That could work. Two asks: 1) can we pin the RC artifact so anything we run between 09:00-11:00 uses the same build? 2) contingency rollback plan if vendor deploy triggers sla alarms.
jen: For 1) we can pin via the artifact service: `pin-artifact --id=2026.03.20-rc2 --until=2026-03-21T00:00Z` — ops will need to approve.
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] Artifact 2026.03.20-rc2 available. To pin, run: `deployctl pin --artifact 2026.03.20-rc2 --expires 2026-03-21T00:00Z`. Approvals required: eng-release, oncall.
kevin: For rollback options: preference is in-place rollback for canary traffic (traffic-shift back to previous stable) + no-downtime DB rollback (we avoid reversing migration). If migration is non-reversible we need pre-promote feature flag gating.
sasha: Migration is backward compatible; we add new column with default. So safe. But migrations will be on main db; vendor deploys touching infra could cause cascade.
olga: Ops: we can reserve 2 dedicated nodes for finance during 09:00-10:30, isolating their deploy. That means our canary will run on separate pool — acceptable?
maria: Yes, isolation preferred. Means we need to set routing policy in rollout config: `route: pool=redwood-canary && exclusive=true`. Also need to ensure latency SLO checks for canary.
jen: QA: we need smoke tests for promo. I'll run a quick regression suite at 08:00 UTC and then again pre-cutover at 08:45. If any red flags, hold promo.
qa-bot: [CI] Smoke run 08:00 -> 12 tests failed (flaky). Most failures are unrelated timeouts. Recommend manual sanity.
alan: Can someone triage the 12 flaky tests before 08:30? I'd rather not proceed with known flakes.
kevin: I'll take the top 5 flaky cases. @jen can you validate the rest?
jen: yes, on it.
maria: Decision proposal: swap slots — finance gets 09:00-10:15 with reserved nodes; we take 10:30 cutover with artifact pinned to 2026.03.20-rc2; canary 30% for 20 mins, then 100% ramp if metrics OK. Rollback: immediate traffic revert + abort migration if we detect error rate >1% or 95th latency >800ms.
sasha: +1 for proposal. Need sign-off from oncall and product.
olga: Ops sign-off: we can reserve nodes and set routing. Will prepare a short runbook.
alan: Product sign-off pending marketing confirm — they agreed to relax 09:00 requirement if we can guarantee final prod by EOD.
maria: OK — can we get approvals here? If you approve, reply with "+1 pin" or "hold".
kevin: +1 pin
omaria: (typo) maria: noted.
jen: +1 pin — QA will hold on final smoke until 08:45.
olga: +1 pin — ops ready.
sasha: +1 pin — product will confirm but I expect yes.
alan: +1 pin.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] Approval summary: approvers: kevin, jen, olga, sasha, alan. Artifact pinned via `deployctl pin` executed by oncall.
deploy-bot: [SCHEDULE] Proposed promo start: 2026-03-21T10:30:00Z; canary 20m at 30% -> 50% -> 100% over 45m.
maria: Thanks. Oncall, please run pin now and publish runbook to #eng-releases.
olga: Oncall (kevin) running pin now...
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] `deployctl pin --artifact 2026.03.20-rc2 --expires 2026-03-21T00:00Z` executed by kevin at 2026-03-21T02:12:00Z UTC. Pin id: pin-9f8c.
kevin: Pin complete. Published short runbook link: https://internal.company/runbooks/pin-2026-03-20-rc2
maria: All right — marketing please relist final timelines, ops will send reserved node details. We'll reconvene at 08:30 for last smoke check. :thumbsup:
